verdict.rationale: Brex's own docs show admins can create named API tokens in the dashboard and choose the level of data access as scopes, so a dedicated least-privilege credential can be issued for an agent, including one using the official MCP server. The evidence covers only the core: it does not say how fine-grained the scopes are, whether tokens expire or can be revoked, or how a token ties to an agent identity. Missing for 10: documented scope granularity (read vs write per API), token expiry/rotation/revocation controls, agent-specific credential guidance for MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration.
